allowSame.rsa.lblQInv: qInv is a camelCase variable-name abbreviation (like dP/dQ elsewhere on this page), not a natural-language word — kept identical in every language, the same treatment this project already gives gcd/mod notation.
allowSame.rsa.thBit: 'bit' is spelled identically in Dutch, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, European Portuguese, Swedish, Norwegian Bokmål, Romanian and Hungarian — genuine cognate, the standard computing term in all these languages (Italian added by quick task 261002-c77, Polish added by quick task 261002-fmi, Brazilian and European Portuguese added by quick task 261002-jh4, Swedish and Norwegian Bokmål added by quick task 261002-s7l, Romanian and Hungarian added by quick task 261003-0dr). Greek (added by quick task 261003-57k) also keeps 'bit' identical to English — the standard loanword in Greek technical writing; Russian uses its own transliteration бит instead. Albanian (added 2026-10-07 by quick task 261007-k4o) also keeps "bit", its standard computing term, while Swahili writes biti. Indonesian (added 2026-10-08 by quick task 261008-0h2) also writes bit unchanged, its standard computing term.
allowSame.rsa.thExpression: French 'expression' is spelled identically to English — genuine cognate.
allowSame.rsa.crtDirectVsLine: French 'direct' is spelled identically to English — genuine cognate (kept as the natural French word for this formula label).

allowLiteral.eve-factor-: DOM id prefix (template-literal interpolation `eve-factor-${id}`), not prose.
allowLiteral.msg-: DOM id prefix (template-literal interpolation `msg-${fromId}` / `msg-${toId}`), not prose.
allowLiteral.send-: DOM id prefix (template-literal interpolation `send-${fromId}-btn`), not prose.
allowLiteral.crt-toggle-: DOM id prefix (template-literal interpolation `crt-toggle-${toId}`), not prose.
allowLiteral.h = qInv·(m1 − m2) mod p =: Notation label built as a plain textContent assignment with no child nodes (lblH, rsa.html) — qInv is the one camelCase abbreviation in it; the rest is pure formula notation, so the whole literal is never passed through translate() in any language.

allowRenderText.qInv = q: Rendered fragment of rsa.lblQInv before its <sup>-1</sup> child — qInv is a camelCase abbreviation, not a natural-language word (dictionary-level allowSame mirrored here for the runtime langs check).
allowRenderText.h = qInv·(m1 − m2) mod p =: The full literal lblH.textContent assignment in rsa.html (no child nodes to split it into a shorter fragment) — qInv is the one camelCase abbreviation in it; the rest is pure formula notation (dictionary-level allowLiteral mirrored here for the runtime langs check). Identical in every language by construction, so it is only caught by a langs-check index coincidence when a language's segment count exactly matches English's (observed for sv/nb, added by quick task 261002-s7l).

Greek (added by quick task 261003-57k) also keeps 'bit' identical to English, the standard loanword in Greek technical writing. Albanian (added 2026-10-07 by quick task 261007-k4o) also keeps "bit", its standard computing term, while Swahili writes biti. Indonesian (added 2026-10-08 by quick task 261008-0h2) also writes bit unchanged, its standard computing term.
allowRenderText.expression: French 'expression' is spelled identically to English — genuine cognate (dictionary-level allowSame mirrored here for the runtime langs check).
